summary: Hallador Energy Company (HNRG) filed an 8-K on May 30, 2026, announcing it entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement (APA) with Energy World Corporation Ltd. to acquire ~460 MW of Siemens gas turbines, generators, a steam turbine, and ancillary equipment for $350 million. The filing does not state the board recommendation, premium, or advisor. The deal is a straightforward cash acquisition of physical assets. The APA is filed as an exhibit. The registrant is an acquirer in this special situation acquisition, which is expected to close pending customary conditions.
